lakeSource: HydroLAKES v1.0 (every polygon, no area filter)
method: scripts/data-build/nbs_inventory.py --lakes HydroLAKES_polys_v10.shp --min-area-km2 0 --measure. coverage is the share of lake cells inside delivered tiles by source kind, read at no more than 512 px per tile side; footprint is the share of the lake inside delivered tile bounds; surveyedShare = footprint x coverage.survey. blueTopo marks lakes that BlueTopo tile bounds also meet (not measured).
